raw.description:
PR Specialist

Seeking.com | Full-Time, Exempt, Remote (US) | Reports to: PR Manager

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, and we are in the middle of the most important chapter of our brand transformation. You will not be coordinating from the sidelines. You will be pitching journalists, drafting press releases, and running the day-to-day operations of our member casting book.

This is the right role for an ambitious specialist who wants to be promoted to PR Manager in two to three years, and who knows that the way to get there is by doing the work.

Core Responsibilities

Writing, Pitching & Media Relations

  • Draft press releases, media alerts, pitch emails, op-eds, Q&As, fact sheets, executive bios, and briefing books for review
  • Pitch journalists, editors, podcast bookers, producers, bloggers, and influencers directly on the beats you own
  • Build and grow personal media relationships across dating, lifestyle, business, consumer tech, and culture beats
  • Maintain personal media-readiness: keep talking points current and be comfortable on camera and in audio
  • Respond to inbound media requests with speed and route information across the company • Identify and act on PR opportunities through Qwoted, HARO, and similar platforms daily • Help trend-hijack: bring at least two news-cycle insertion opportunities to the Senior PR Manager every week with a draft pitch attached
  • Edit and proofread your own work and your peers' work to AP-style standard before it goes to management
  • Complete media training as the company offers it

Member Casting & Storyteller Book

  • Run the day-to-day operations of the member casting book under management’s direction • Recruit members into the book continuously
  • Vet members for media-readiness, brief them on outlet, journalist, angle, and message tracks before every press interaction
  • Match the right member to the right journalist request and coordinate availability inside hours • Manage all NDAs, consent forms, and post-interview follow-ups for member interviewees • Keep the casting book tagged, searchable, and current

•

Co-CEO & Executive Visibility Support

  • Help build the pipeline of podcast, interview, and speaking opportunities for our Co-CEOs • Draft briefing materials, narrative arcs, and message tracks for executive appearances • Research awards relevant to the brand and prepare submissions for the manager's review • Coordinate stage and panel opportunities at relevant conferences

Trend-Mining & Cultural Listening

  • Monitor news, newsletters, X, and competitor PR daily across dating, relationships, lifestyle, business, and tech
  • Maintain a running calendar of recurring cultural moments and pre-build pitches around them • Track competitor PR activity and flag where they are taking share of conversation we should be contesting

Operations, Reporting & Asset Management

  • Maintain media lists, pitch calendars, journalist contact databases, and CRM tracking • Maintain the PR asset library: approved imagery, boilerplates, key messaging, executive bios, and media kits
  • Monitor daily media coverage using Muck Rack, Cision, Meltwater, Google Alerts, and similar tools
  • Compile weekly coverage summaries and contribute to monthly PR reports • Maintain SOPs and process documentation for recurring workflows
  • Help maintain crisis communication resources and contact lists

Required Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years of experience in PR (agency or in-house), journalism, or communications • Bachelor's degree in Public Relations, Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or related field, or equivalent professional track record
  • Demonstrated track record contributing to or personally securing media coverage (regional, trade, or national outlets)
  • Strong writing and editing skills with a portfolio of work you can point to
  • Working knowledge of Muck Rack, Cision, Meltwater, or equivalent, plus Qwoted/HARO, plus AP style

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience at a top consumer or lifestyle PR agency
  • AI fluency. You already use ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or similar tools to research, draft first passes, build media lists, and analyze coverage
  • Newsroom experience as a reporter or junior editor
  • Existing relationships with dating, relationships, lifestyle, business, or consumer tech beat reporters
  • Experience with member, customer, or talent casting for media stories
  • Comfort with reputation work for brands that carry public-perception baggage Compensation & Benefits
  • Base salary: $80,000 to $100,000, commensurate with experience
  • Full-time, exempt, fully remote within the US
  • Health, dental, vision, 401(k), and standard benefits package
  • A manager who will actively coach you and a real path to Senior PR Manager

About the Operations team The Operations team delivers seamless customer experiences and enables new product capabilities while ensuring operational excellence. The team owns strategy, planning, technical execution, customer service, fraud operations, process design, quality, training, and program management. We drive efficiency, resolve issues quickly, and scale operations as the business grows. Our goal is to deliver seamless support while maintaining high standards and reducing risk.

About the role
Affirm is seeking an Operations Enablement leader to drive scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to scale efficiently while maintaining exceptional customer and merchant outcomes.

You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. As a member of the Operations Enablement team, you will own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives aligned to strategic priorities - driving delivery across timelines, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. You will define and execute servicing strategies by developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans and be responsible for planning, coordination, documentation, change management and measurement across assigned initiatives to ensure operational readiness and measurable outcomes.

This role works closely with partners across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure readiness for key business and regulatory changes. Serving as a connector between servicing strategy and day-to-day execution, you will translate strategy into scalable operational capabilities. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.

What you'll do

  • Own Program Performance: Lead complex cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities.

  • Set Strategic Direction: Define and execute the servicing strategy developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans, tracking progress against KPIs, timelines, and budgets.

  • Lead Transformation Initiatives: Drive enterprise-wide improvements leveraging Lean Six Sigma, change management, and data-driven methodologies to unlock efficiency, compliance, and customer satisfaction.

  • Build Technical Resources: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate technical concepts into clear manuals and resources for both human and AI agents.

  • Elevate Knowledge Management: Architect and evolve our knowledge ecosystem (SOPs, job aids, learning platforms, AI-enabled knowledge tools), ensuring resources are accurate, engaging, and accessible at scale.

  • Translate Technical Concepts: Apply technical depth to plan, design, and create complex operational, instructional, and procedural content, translating technical concepts into clear resources for both human and AI agents.

  • Own Learning & Training Strategy: Oversee end-to-end design and delivery of training programs (onboarding, continuous learning, new product rollouts), ensuring effectiveness through measurement and feedback loops.

  • Champion Global Readiness: Anticipate and design for operational needs tied to product launches, program expansion, and regulatory changes.

  • Drive Insights: Use metrics, dashboards, and qualitative feedback to continuously assess workflows, knowledge adoption, training impact, and localization quality, while influencing senior leadership decisions.

  • Influence & Partner at Scale: Serve as a trusted advisor to executives, cross-functional partners, and vendor leaders - driving alignment between company goals and day-to-day execution.

  • Build a High-Performing Ecosystem: Lead and coach augmented staff, contractors, and cross-functional contributors to deliver world-class content and learning experiences.

  • Lead Change at Scale: Ensure global teams successfully adopt new processes, platforms, and resources through structured change management practices.

  • Expand Program Scope: Take on additional program and project management responsibilities as needed, developing working knowledge across adjacent domains to support evolving business needs.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of experience in program management or product operations, preferably within large-scale or global operations.

  • Proven track record of setting strategy and delivering measurable impact across efficiency, compliance, and customer experience.

  • Expertise in Lean Six Sigma, project/program management, and change management (Black Belt, PMP, or Prosci certification preferred).

  • Experience implementing and scaling knowledge management and training (Salesforce, Confluence, LMS platforms, or AI-driven knowledge tools).

  • Strong background in regulated industries (financial services, fintech, or consumer lending highly preferred).

  • Exceptional influence and communication skills, with the ability to engage executives, coach teams, and align diverse stakeholders.

  • Analytical and data-driven mindset, with a focus on measurable outcomes and continuous improvement.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, high-growth environments with a builder’s mindset.

  • Global perspective with experience supporting vendor/partner operations and distributed teams.

  • Willingness to travel up to 20–30% to support global sites and vendor partners.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $101,000 - $151,000 CAD

# LI-Remote

Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company! The majority of our roles are remote and you can work almost anywhere within the country of employment. Affirmers in proximal roles have the flexibility to work remotely, but will occasionally be required to work out of their assigned Affirm office. A limited number of roles remain office-based due to the nature of their job responsibilities.

We’re extremely proud to offer competitive benefits that are anchored to our core value of people come first. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:

  • Health care coverage - Affirm covers all premiums for all levels of coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible Spending Wallets - generous stipends for spending on Technology, Food, various Lifestyle needs, and family forming expenses
  • Time off - competitive vacation and holiday schedules allowing you to take time off to rest and recharge
  • ESPP - An employee stock purchase plan enabling you to buy shares of Affirm at a discount

We believe It’s On Us to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

[For U.S. positions that could be performed in Los Angeles or San Francisco] Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance and Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Affirm will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a strong understanding of security principles, and enjoys solving complex problems to reduce risk. You’ll analyze vulnerabilities across diverse systems, collaborate with cross-functional teams to prioritize and remediate findings, and help enhance our processes and tooling to strengthen the organization’s security posture.

Responsibilities:

  • Perform recurring and on-demand scanning of organizational systems and cloud environments

  • Research and assess emerging security threats and vulnerabilities

  • Communicate the risks of identified vulnerabilities and recommend security controls to mitigate them

  • Collaborate with IT and development teams to develop and implement remediation plans for identified vulnerabilities

  • Monitor and track the progress of remediation efforts to ensure vulnerabilities are resolved within defined SLAs

  • Maintain documentation regarding vulnerability management, including policies and procedures

  • Ensure compliance with industry standards, regulatory requirements, and best practices related to vulnerability management

  • Improveand matureexisting vulnerability managementprocesses and systems

  • Provide technical support for vulnerability management projects

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts, risks, and remediation guidance to non-technical stakeholders

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce clear documentation, reports, and stakeholder-facing materials

  • Strong organizational and time management abilities, with experience managing multiple workstreams, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

  • Experience with system and application security posture management, including configuration hardening and alignment with security best practices

Anteris® Technologies is a global structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care. With offices in Minneapolis, MN, US; Geneva, Switzerland; and Brisbane and Perth, Australia, we have a growing and inclusive team.

Our mission is to forge new frontiers in cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Transcatheter Aortic Valve Replacement (TAVR) technologies were originally designed for older, high-risk patients. Today, younger, more active patients need a better solution that will not just open and close but restore healthy heart function. We seek to restore healthy blood flow patterns by creating the world’s first biomimetic TAVR valve, DurAVR® THV. This cutting-edge valve, incorporating our proprietary ADAPT® anti-calcification technology, is designed to mimic the natural function of a healthy heart valve.

The Clinical Imaging Specialist plays a critical role in supporting patient screening and procedural planning activities for Anteris global clinical studies. This individual performs detailed review and analysis of cardiac CT imaging, supports patient eligibility assessments, and collaborates closely with physicians, Clinical Science, Clinical Operations, Therapy Development, and Field Clinical teams to facilitate enrollment and procedural planning across multinational clinical trial sites.

Reporting to the Director of Therapy and Technology Advancement, this role requires deep knowledge of structural heart anatomy, cardiac CT imaging, and TAVR patient evaluation. The Clinical Imaging Specialist serves as a key clinical resource by delivering consistent, high-quality imaging assessments while supporting efficient patient screening and case planning throughout Anteris' global clinical programs.

This is a remote position based within Europe. Preference will be given to candidates located in or near Geneva, CH, or those near a major international airport to support occasional travel (approximately 10%) for investigator meetings, physician training, internal meetings, and clinical site visits throughout Europe and other global locations. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in their country of residence.

At Anteris Technologies, you'll join a mission-driven team dedicated to improving the lives of patients with aortic stenosis through breakthrough structural heart technologies while helping shape the future of structural heart care.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

Imaging Review & Patient Screening

  • Perform detailed review and analysis of cardiac CT scans for patients being considered for enrollment in global clinical studies.
  • Evaluate imaging data to support patient eligibility and screening decisions.
  • Assess anatomical characteristics relevant to TAVR procedural planning, including aortic annulus sizing, vascular access, calcium distribution, coronary heights, valve morphology, and other structural heart considerations.
  • Utilize advanced imaging platforms, including 3Mensio or equivalent software, to perform measurements and generate screening reports.
  • Identify and escalate imaging findings that may impact patient eligibility, procedural planning, or study participation.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of imaging assessments, recommendations, and screening outcomes.

Clinical Trial Support

  • Collaborate with Clinical Science, Clinical Operations, Therapy Development, and Field Clinical teams across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific to support timely patient screening and enrollment activities.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary case review discussions, screening conferences, and physician review meetings.
  • Prepare and present patient imaging analyses during screening conferences and physician case planning sessions.
  • Support protocol compliance and consistency in imaging review processes across participating global clinical sites.
  • Contribute to the development, refinement, and standardization of imaging review workflows and best practices.

Physician & Site Collaboration

  • Serve as a clinical imaging resource for investigators, physicians, study coordinators, and site personnel regarding imaging requirements and screening processes.
  • Partner with physicians and Field Clinical Specialists to facilitate patient-specific procedural planning discussions.
  • Communicate imaging findings clearly and effectively to both internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist clinical sites in obtaining complete, high-quality CT imaging submissions.

Quality & Compliance

  • Ensure all activities are performed in accordance with applicable global regulatory requirements, ICH-GCP guidelines, company policies, and quality system requirements.
  • Maintain patient confidentiality and data privacy in accordance with GDPR, applicable local privacy regulations, and study requirements.
  • Support audit readiness, inspection preparedness, and documentation compliance.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives related to imaging review, patient screening, and clinical operations.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting structural heart or cardiovascular imaging.
  • Demonstrated experience performing advanced TAVR CT analysis using 3Mensio or equivalent imaging software.
  • Experience reviewing cardiac CT imaging and supporting TAVR patient evaluation and procedural planning.
  • Strong understanding of structural heart anatomy, cardiac CT imaging principles, and transcatheter valve therapies.
  • Experience supporting clinical research, medical device companies, or hospital-based structural heart programs.
  • Strong organizational skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively across geographically dispersed global teams.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken) is required. Professional proficiency in German is strongly preferred; additional European languages are considered an asset.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to approximately 10%.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certification in a relevant cardiac imaging modality (ARRT, RDCS, RCS, or equivalent).
  • Five or more years of structural heart or cardiovascular imaging experience.
  • Prior experience supporting structural heart clinical trials.
  • Experience participating in multidisciplinary Heart Team discussions.
  • Experience supporting multinational or European clinical studies.
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, European MDR, FDA clinical trial requirements, and global clinical research regulations.
  • Previous experience working within a medical device company developing Class III cardiovascular technologies.

Key Competencies

  • Cardiac CT imaging expertise
  • Structural heart and TAVR knowledge
  • Clinical judgment and patient assessment
  • Attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Cross-functional collaboration
  • Written and verbal communication
  • Critical thinking and problem solving
  • Organization and prioritization
  • Adaptability in a global environment
  • Commitment to quality and compliance

Note: We may require proof of COVID-19 vaccination to comply with health institutions, state, local municipality, and/or travel regulations.

Anteris Technologies recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law. We have a clear vision: to be a place of belonging for all humans by promoting diversity, multiculturism and inclusion, as a goal and reflection across the organization. Diversity is more than a commitment - it is part of our mission to deliver the best structural heart products on a global scale.

DevOps Automation Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: DevOps Automation Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $75,000–$95,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an DevOps Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Strong Git-based workflows including code review, branching, and release management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cloud Terraform (AWS + Azure or AWS + GCP).
  • Familiarity with Terragrunt, Atlantis, Spacelift, or env0.
  • Experience with policy-as-code engines (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov).
  • Contributions to public Terraform modules or providers.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and tagging-driven cost governance.

Manager of Support Services

Harris Recording Solutions

View All Locations
Time Type: Full Time

Harris Recording Solutions (HRS), a leading provider of software solutions for county government and official records organizations, is seeking a Manager of Support Services to lead the day-to-day operations of our Support Services team and ensure we consistently deliver exceptional service to our customers.

The Manager of Support Services will be responsible for managing support operations, developing employees, monitoring performance, improving processes, and ensuring customer issues are addressed efficiently and professionally.

This role will work closely with Client Services leadership, Product, Development, Professional Services, Sales, and other internal teams to advocate for customers, identify recurring issues, improve support processes, and strengthen the overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate is an experienced support leader who is organized, accountable, customer-focused, and comfortable managing a team in a fast-paced software environment. This individual should have a strong understanding of support operations, performance management, customer communication, escalation management, and continuous improvement.

AI & Innovation Mindset

Harris Recording Solutions is committed to using emerging technologies to improve how we work and serve our customers.

The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to adopt and leverage AI, automation, knowledge management, and other technology solutions to improve support workflows, increase efficiency, and enhance the customer experience.

The Manager of Support Services will help identify opportunities to automate repetitive work, improve knowledge resources, leverage AI-assisted support tools, and reduce unnecessary manual effort while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and customer service standards.

What Your Impact Will Be

Support Team Leadership

  • Manage the day-to-day activities of the Support Services team.
  • Provide leadership, coaching, mentoring, and ongoing development to support employees.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold employees accountable for results.
  • Monitor individual and team performance and address performance issues promptly.
  • Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, and team meetings.
  • Identify employee strengths, development opportunities, and career growth paths.
  • Help develop future leaders within the Support organization.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, teamwork, and customer advocacy.
  • Ensure team members have the training, tools, documentation, and resources needed to perform their roles effectively.

Operational Excellence

  • Monitor daily support operations to ensure customers receive timely and effective assistance.
  • Manage ticket queues, assignments, priorities, escalations, and workload distribution.
  • Monitor key support metrics, including:
    • Response times
    • Resolution times
    • SLA performance
    • Ticket backlog
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Ticket quality
    • Productivity
    • Escalations
    • Aging tickets
  • Identify trends and operational issues and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure support processes are consistently followed and documented.
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, eliminate unnecessary steps, and increase team efficiency.
  • Maintain appropriate coverage and resource allocation based on customer demand.
  • Help establish and maintain support standards across HRS product lines.
  • Ensure aging and stagnant tickets are actively managed and appropriately escalated.
  • Monitor critical incidents and ensure appropriate communication and follow-up.

Customer Experience & Escalations

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex or sensitive customer issues.
  • Work directly with customers when additional management involvement is required.
  • Ensure customer concerns are communicated clearly and professionally.
  • Monitor escalated issues through resolution and ensure appropriate follow-up occurs.
  • Identify recurring customer issues and work with internal teams to address root causes.
  • Advocate for customers while balancing customer needs with company policies and business objectives.
  • Help strengthen customer relationships through consistent, proactive, and professional support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product and Development to communicate recurring customer issues and product feedback.
  • Identify trends in support tickets that may indicate product defects, training opportunities, or documentation gaps.
  • Work with Product and Development teams to improve product quality and reduce recurring support issues.
  • Collaborate with Professional Services and Client Services to ensure smooth customer handoffs and issue resolution.
  • Partner with internal teams during product releases, upgrades, implementations, and major customer initiatives.
  • Provide leadership with regular updates regarding support trends, customer concerns, staffing, and operational performance.

Knowledge Management & Process Improvement

  • Help develop and maintain a strong knowledge management program for internal employees and customers.
  • Identify opportunities to convert recurring support issues into knowledge articles, documentation, training materials, and self-service resources.
  • Ensure support documentation is accurate, current, and easy for employees to use.
  • Promote the use of knowledge articles and self-service tools to improve resolution times and reduce unnecessary tickets.
  • Identify opportunities to standardize processes across Support Services.
  • Participate in continuous improvement initiatives designed to improve customer service and team efficiency.

AI & Automation

  • Promote the effective use of AI and automation within Support Services.
  • Identify repetitive support activities that can be automated or assisted through technology.
  • Encourage adoption of AI-assisted ticket management, knowledge search, ticket summarization, response assistance, and other support tools.
  • Monitor the effectiveness of AI-enabled support tools and provide feedback for improvement.
  • Help ensure AI-generated information and responses are reviewed appropriately and maintain HRS standards for accuracy and customer service.
  • Partner with leadership to identify opportunities to increase ticket deflection and reduce manual workload through automation and self-service.

Reporting & Performance Management

  • Maintain visibility into Support Services performance through regular reporting and analysis.
  • Review team metrics and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Prepare regular updates for Client Services leadership regarding:
    • Ticket volume
    • Backlog
    • SLA performance
    • Customer satisfaction
    • Escalations
    • Staffing
    • Productivity
    • Major customer issues
    • Operational trends
  • Use data to identify risks and make recommendations for improving support performance.
  • Establish team goals and track progress against those goals.

Travel Requirements

Limited travel may be required, typically not to exceed 10–20%, primarily for customer engagements, conferences, team meetings, training, or business planning sessions.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in software support, technical support, customer service, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience managing or supervising a support or customer-facing team.
  • Experience supporting enterprise software or SaaS products.
  • Experience managing ticket queues, support metrics, escalations, and service levels.
  • Strong understanding of customer support operations and best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to coach, develop, and hold employees accountable for performance.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work effectively with Product, Development, Client Services, Professional Services, and other internal teams.
  • Experience with ticketing systems, knowledge management platforms, reporting tools, and customer support technologies.
  • Experience with AI, automation, or other emerging technologies is preferred.
  • Experience working with county government, public sector software, land records, or government technology is a plus.
  • Ability to effectively manage customer escalations and difficult customer situations.
  • Demonstrated commitment to providing exceptional customer service.
  • Ability to work independently while also functioning effectively as part of a distributed team.
  • Ability to travel as needed for customer and business engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means the Support Services team is organized, accountable, responsive, and customer-focused.

The Manager of Support Services will ensure that:

  • Customers receive timely and professional support.
  • Tickets are actively managed and resolved within established expectations.
  • Backlogs and aging tickets are proactively addressed.
  • Employees understand their responsibilities and performance expectations.
  • Support metrics are consistently monitored and improved.
  • Recurring customer issues are identified and communicated to the appropriate teams.
  • Knowledge and self-service resources continue to improve.
  • AI and automation are used to increase efficiency and reduce manual workload.
  • The Support Services team operates as a strong partner to customers and the broader HRS organization.

Salary Range: $75,000 - $85,000 USD per year.

raw.title: Health Plan Associate, Program Management
raw.excerpt: Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities.
raw.description:
Habitat Health empowers older adults to experience more good days in their homes and communities. Through the Program of All-Inclusive Care for the Elderly (PACE), we provide comprehensive medical care along with support for daily needs such as meals, transportation, and in‑home assistance. We deliver coordinated clinical and social care in our centers and directly in participants’ homes, creating a fully integrated experience that brings peace of mind and a true sense of belonging. As we expand our scalable, affordable PACE model to meet the growing and complex needs of aging populations, our mission‑driven care teams continue to help participants live well on their own terms.

Habitat Health is supported by leading healthcare organizations and investors including New Enterprise Associates, Kaiser Permanente, and Town Hall Ventures. We are entering a period of significant growth and are looking for exceptional teammates to help us scale a better model of care for older adults. To learn more, visit www.habitathealth.com.

Role Scope:

We are looking for a detail oriented, results driven individual who will drive assigned program outcomes from initiation to close-out in a defined timeframe. The Health Plan Associate – Program Management plays a central role in coordinating and monitoring cross-functional projects that span claims, authorizations, pharmacy (Part D), provider network, eligibility/census management, member services, and other Health Plan program management.

This role focuses on project execution, risk identification, and operational readiness, helping the Health Plan leadership team ensure key initiatives, regulatory deliverables, and performance improvements stay on track across all areas for both current and future Health Plan products.

  • Lead cross-functional healthcare projects, initiatives, and operational process improvements for the Health Plan function
  • Drive projects and initiatives that cut across multiple domains (e.g., new vendor implementations, regulatory audits, process standardization, data integrity efforts) and maintain the end-to-end work plan for Health Plan operations — enrollment, authorizations, claims, pharmacy, and network performance — identifying risks, dependencies, and inefficiencies along the way.
  • Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and resource/timeline estimates; partner with subject-matter experts (e.g., Claims, Compliance, Provider Network, Data & Analytics) to document processes and design improvements aligned to regulatory and organizational goals.
  • Coordinate and facilitate project meetings with internal stakeholders and external partners, and track outcomes against operational metrics (e.g., timeliness, accuracy, compliance adherence).
  • Follow up with responsible parties to ensure timely completion of open items, correcting course when work goes beyond scope or off-target, and escalate barriers to Health Plan leadership as needed.
  • Own Health Plan regulatory processes and filings, ensuring strict adherence to critical timelines
  • Serve as the primary point of accountability for assigned regulatory filings, reporting submissions, and compliance deliverables, ensuring accuracy and on-time completion.
  • Maintain a master regulatory calendar of response windows, due dates, and filing deadlines, proactively flagging upcoming items well in advance of when they are due.
  • Balance time-sensitive regulatory obligations against day-to-day functions and ongoing projects, escalating potential conflicts early to protect critical due dates.
  • Serve as the Health Plan lead for go-live readiness on new center openings
  • Represent the Health Plan function in go-live planning and readiness activities, ensuring Health Plan requirements, systems, and processes are in place ahead of each new center launch.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to track go-live readiness milestones, resolve open items, and confirm operational readiness prior to launch.

Qualifications

  • Aligns with our purpose and values and is excited about living those out in daily practice.
  • 2-4 years of demonstrated experience, knowledge, and a track record in project management techniques, concepts, principles, and standards. Specific healthcare and/or health plan experience required.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to effectively communicate at all levels internally and externally to establish credibility on project teams.
  • Can skillfully navigate multiple external systems including those operated by Medicare and Medicaid
  • High proficiency with general Microsoft applications, including Share Point as well as Smartsheet
  • Ability to forecast project challenges and define solutions to maintain compliance with policies and procedures, quality, and schedule.

Nice to have:

  • Prior experience in PACE

Compensation:

The anticipated base salary range for this position is $67,000 - $87,000 annually. This position is also eligible for a target annual bonus and may be eligible for additional incentive compensation, as applicable.

The final compensation offered will be determined based on factors including, but not limited to, the candidate's qualifications, skills, experience, education, certifications, geographical location, and business needs.

In addition, this position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; paid parental leave, short- and long-term disability coverage; life insurance; flexible spending accounts; a 401(k) savings plan that includes a match; paid time off; and company paid holidays.

Vaccination Policy, including COVID-19

To help maintain a safe environment for our participants and team members, Habitat Health maintains vaccination and infection control policies applicable to certain roles and work locations. For COVID-19 and influenza, team members who are working in a participant care setting are required to provide either proof of vaccination or a signed declination form and comply with applicable masking requirements while in a care setting to the extent permitted by law in the applicable jurisdiction.

Habitat Health will consider requests for reasonable accommodation based on an applicant's disability, medical condition, or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance in accordance with applicable law.

As a condition of employment, team members are expected to comply with all applicable infection control protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and vaccination requirements associated with their role and work location, and to the extent required by law and as permitted in the applicable jurisdiction.

Our Commitment to Equal Opportunity and Inclusion

Habitat Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to the principles of equal opportunity and inclusion. Employment decisions at Habitat Health are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. This role partners closely with Operations, Workforce Design, Technology, Product, and Digital Strategy leaders to ensure people, processes, and technology capabilities evolve in alignment with organizational priorities and future workforce needs. Close collaboration is maintained with senior-level business partners. Effective leadership entails driving outcomes not only through the team but also by collaborating with peers and leaders both internally and externally within the context of PAIT operations.

The decisions made by this director carry significant weight and have lasting impacts on the overall operational and financial performance of the business.

Job Title: Product Owner, Media OS, IQVIA Digital

Job Location: Wayne, Pennsylvania, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

IQVIA Digital powers exceptional brand experiences, delivering innovative solutions based on a customer-first, insights-driven, and integrated omnichannel vision. We provide authenticated, privacy-enhanced data and analytics, innovative fit-for-purpose healthcare technology, and the expertise to enable an effective and adaptable marketing model that drives better quality of care and patient outcomes. IQVIA is the leading global provider of data, advanced analytics, technology solutions and clinical research services for the life sciences industry. Learn more at

Product

The Product team is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for IQVIA Digital's portfolio of data, technology, and media solutions. Through close partnership with clients and cross-functional collaboration with Go-to-Market, Technology, Data Management, and Operations teams, the team translates market insights and customer needs into innovative, scalable products. Built upon IQVIA's industry-leading healthcare data assets and privacy-by-design foundation, these solutions deliver differentiated value to clients, drive business growth, and advance IQVIA Digital's leadership in the healthcare marketing ecosystem.

Media OS is a foundational pillar of IQVIA Digital’s growth strategy, particularly as we scale agency partnerships and deepen our focus on customer-centric marketing. The platform plays a critical role in how IQVIA activates its differentiated healthcare data across digital channels, powering media execution, informing planning decisions, and driving measurable outcomes.

The Product Owner will be responsible for defining and executing the product strategy for a specific area of Media OS, with a focus on growing media and digital data spend that originates in or is executed through the platform. This includes partnering cross-functionally with engineering, GTM, client services, and strategy teams to deliver best-in-class capabilities across audience creation, planning, and activation.

Job Overview
Owns the roadmap for integrations between our internal platform and third-party AdTech, marketing, and SaaS systems. This role delivers incremental value aligned to defined business goals, driving execution across audience creation, planning, ad buying, and measurement workflows. This candidate will also build trust with engineers and other internal stakeholders, contribute to product strategy, and ensure integrations are robust, scalable, and aligned with client and business needs.

Essential Functions:

  • Builds and executes a roadmap for integrations with third-party platforms such as DSPs, SSPs, DMPs, CRMs, etc. to support omnichannel healthcare marketing.
  • Develops strong, collaborative relationships across engineering, client services, operations and GTM teams.
  • Translates roadmap initiatives into actionable user stories and detailed requirements with clear acceptance criteria.
  • Owns the full lifecycle of platform integrations—including planning, implementation, testing, release coordination, and support—for use cases including audience activation, ad buying and delivery, and measurement.
  • Leads product discovery to improve predictability and ROI for development efforts.
  • Prioritizes backlog items based on impact, feasibility, and alignment to broader product strategy.
  • Partners with support, engineering, and operations teams to triage and resolve platform or integration-related issues in a timely manner.
  • Supports internal enablement through documentation, training, demos, and cross-functional alignment.
  • Monitors product health and performance, resolves issues, and incorporates internal and client feedback into future iterations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a technical, quantitative, or related liberal arts field (e.g., Computer Science, Economics, Data Science, or similar), or equivalent experience.
  • 4–6 years of product management or product ownership experience, ideally within AdTech, MarTech, or digital media.
  • Experience managing SaaS platform integrations and third-party partnerships, including onboarding third-party data, resolving identities, and activating audiences across media platforms.
  • Familiarity with systems like The Trade Desk, LiveRamp, Snowflake, and Salesforce is a plus.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with a demonstrated ability to
  • Proficient in Agile development workflows; experienced in writing user stories, managing backlogs, and running sprint ceremonies.
  • Analytical mindset with an understanding of data flows, event tracking, and system integrations in digital advertising environments.
  • Experience working in regulated industries like healthcare or life sciences is preferred.
  • Familiarity with privacy frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, consent-based targeting) and data governance best practices is a plus.

Nous recherchons un technicien de support technique pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique au sein d'une entreprise technologique spécialisée dans les systèmes de point de vente (POS).

Le candidat retenu sera chargé de fournir un support technique de qualité en répondant aux appels téléphoniques et aux demandes par e-mail afin de résoudre efficacement les problèmes des clients. Il sera également chargé de coordonner les demandes adressées à l'équipe nécessitant une expertise de plus haut niveau.

Tâches et responsabilités :

  • Répondre aux appels et aux courriels entrants afin d'aider les clients à résoudre leurs problèmes techniques ou de répondre à leurs questions.
  • Identifier, diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes techniques courants rencontrés par les clients. Cela implique des interactions par téléphone et par courriel.
  • Documenter de manière exhaustive les problèmes de niveau supérieur et assurer le suivi avec l'équipe.
  • Décrire les problèmes liés aux logiciels ou les mesures à prendre et assurer le suivi avec l'équipe technique à l'aide d'un outil technologique.
  • Effectuer des tests sur les produits et le matériel afin de diagnostiquer correctement les problèmes et assurer le suivi avec l'équipe technique.
  • Participer aux réunions d'équipe liées au support technique.
  • Collaborer avec les autres membres de l'équipe pour garantir une résolution rapide et efficace des problèmes.
  • Recueillir des informations sur les problèmes récurrents ou les suggestions des clients afin d'améliorer continuellement le produit.
  • Participer à l'amélioration de la base de connaissances actuelle et à la création d'une nouvelle base en lien avec la prochaine version.
  • Importer des fichiers dans les systèmes des clients.
  • Participer à l'intégration des clients.

Compétences requises :

  • Expérience en service à la clientèle.
  • Une bonne maîtrise du français et de l’anglais est requise car le titulaire du poste aura à communiquer fréquemment dans les deux langues, tant oralement que par écrit. Nous avons des collègues, des clients et des partenaires au Québec, ainsi que dans le reste du Canada et aux États-Unis.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication orale et écrite, avec une capacité avérée à expliquer des concepts techniques de manière claire et compréhensible.
  • À l'aise avec la technologie et capable d'apprendre rapidement à utiliser des applications logicielles.
  • Capacité à analyser des situations et à résoudre rapidement des problèmes.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière autonome tout en faisant preuve d'un bon esprit d'équipe.
  • Excellentes compétences organisationnelles et capacité à prendre des notes.
  • Faire preuve de proactivité dans l'exécution des tâches et dans les interactions avec les clients.

Compétences clés :

  • Connaissance pratique des systèmes de point de vente ou des logiciels similaires.
  • Maîtrise des outils de gestion des tickets (par exemple, Jira, HubSpot).
  • Aisance dans l'utilisation des outils d'intelligence artificielle (IA).
  • Expérience dans le commerce de détail.

WHO WE ARE

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com. 

THE ROLE 

Zeta Global is seeking a strategic, client-facing Director to join our ZX Data Science & Analytics team. This role is ideal for an experienced analytics leader who excels at  transforming complex data into compelling narratives, influencing client strategy, and driving measurable business outcomes.

The Director will serve as a trusted analytics partner to clients and internal teams, bringing together marketing measurement, advanced analytics, media strategy, and data storytelling to make insights actionable. This individual will also help scale analytics best practices across clients and categories, strengthen partnerships with Sales and cross-functional teams, and contribute to the continued evolution of ZX Analytics solutions and measurement products.

This position reports to the VP of Data Science & Analytics.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead with Storytelling: Translate complex analytics and media performance into clear, persuasive narratives that connect insights to client business priorities and inspire action.
  • Shape Client Strategy: Develop analytics approaches aligned with client objectives, using insights to inform acquisition, retention, lifetime value, media, and optimization strategies. Serve as a trusted analytics advisor to clients and internal partners.
  • Drive Measurement Excellence: Apply and advocate for best-in-class measurement methodologies, including Test/Holdout-based incrementality measurement. Help clients and internal teams understand the strengths, limitations, and business implications of different measurement approaches.
  • Scale Best Practices: Identify learnings across clients, campaigns, and categories and translate them into repeatable best practices, frameworks, and recommendations that improve the quality and consistency of analytics deliverables.
  • Team Leadership: manage and develop a team of analysts, including coaching, onboarding, workload prioritization, performance management, feedback, recognition, and career development. Mentor mid-level analysts in both technical and client-facing skills.
  • Lead Strategic Initiatives: Serve as analytics lead and subject matter expert for select strategic initiatives, helping define solutions, align stakeholders, and move work from concept through implementation.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner effectively with Sales, Client Services, Client Development, Operations, and other teams to solve client challenges, improve processes, and deliver high-quality analytics solutions with limited senior leadership intervention.
  • Innovate with AI: Support the development, application, and adoption of predictive and adaptive ML/AI solutions, helping translate model outputs into clear business recommendations and client value.

REQUIREMENTS  

  • 10+ years of professional experience in analytics, marketing measurement, data science, media analytics, or a related discipline, with demonstrated progression in responsibility and client impact.
  • Proven ability to translate complex analytics into compelling stories and actionable recommendations for client and business audiences.
  • Strong client-facing experience with excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to command an audience and serve as a model for effective client communication.
  • 3+ years in analytics leadership roles, ideally with team management experience.
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in one or more analytics, measurement, media, or industry domains, with the ability to share knowledge and elevate the capabilities of others.
  • Working familiarity with Python, SQL, Tableau or comparable analytical and visualization tools, as well as experience working with predictive analytics and/or ML/AI models.
  • Ability to operate independently, make sound decisions in support of clients and the business, give and receive feedback effectively, and challenge existing approaches constructively.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s preferred in Business Analytics, Data Science, Economics, or related fields.
  • Experience in Retail, Financial Services, Telecom, or Travel verticals is a plus.

This is a remote role based out of the United States. 

 BENEFITS & PERKS  

  • Flexible PTO  
  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage  
  • Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan  
  • Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance  

SALARY RANGE  

The compensation range for this role is $170,000-$190,000 depending on location and experience.   

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA  

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

PLM Integration Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: PLM Integration Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
PositionType: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
ExperienceRequired: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Windchill Integration Engineer to design, build, and operate integrations connecting PTC Windchill with ERP, MES, CAD, and other engineering and manufacturing systems. In this role you will own the technical integration layer between Windchill and the broader enterprise systems landscape. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on Windchill integration experience and a strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, middleware platforms, and PLM-to-ERP data flows. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and develop integrations between Windchill and ERP systems (SAP, Oracle EBS, Oracle Cloud) using Info*Engine, web services, and middleware platforms.
  • Build CAD integrations for Creo, SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Catia, and NX with Windchill, including check-in/check-out workflows and metadata mapping.
  • Develop integrations between Windchill and MES, MOM, and quality systems.
  • Build REST and SOAP services for Windchill data using OData, Info*Engine, or custom Java services.
  • Implement message-based and event-driven integrations using middleware (MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, SAP CPI).
  • Design and operate robust error-handling, alerting, and resubmission patterns, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Profile and optimize performance of high-volume integrations, applying systematic measurement, targeted improvements, and data-driven validation to deliver quantifiable gains in throughput, latency, or resource efficiency.
  • Lead migration efforts to retire legacy point-to-point integrations and replace them with modern, middleware-mediated patterns, planning phased cutovers, building backward-compatibility shims where needed, and ensuring each migration step is reversible and well-monitored.
  • Collaborate with PLM, ERP, and CAD functional teams to align integrations with business processes.
  • Develop integration documentation, message specifications, and runbooks, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging integration tools and patterns, assessing maturity, fit for purpose, and total cost of ownership, and make grounded recommendations on which to adopt, pilot, or defer based on real engineering needs.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PLM integration experience with a strong focus on Windchill.
  • Hands-on experience with Info*Engine and Windchill Java API.
  • Experience designing PLM-to-ERP integrations (SAP, Oracle).
  • Working knowledge of CAD integration patterns.
  • Experience with middleware platforms such as MuleSoft, Boomi, OIC, or SAP CPI.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with Windchill data model.
  • Experience with REST and SOAP web services.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and documentation skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • PTC Windchill certifications.
  • Experience with ThingWorx or IIoT integration.
  • Exposure to API management platforms.
  • Familiarity with event-driven and Kafka-based integration patterns.
  • Experience operating Windchill in the cloud.

THE PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR IS THE SINGLE POINT OF ACCOUNTABILITY FOR DELIVERING A FULLY OPERATIONAL, CUSTOMER-READY DATA CENTER SAFELY, ON SCHEDULE, WITHIN APPROVED BUDGET, AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE COMPANY’S TECHNICAL, COMMERCIAL, AND OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS.

THE ROLE BEGINS ONCE A SITE HAS PASSED THE COMPANY’S ORIGINATION AND INVESTMENT CRITERIA AND HAS BEEN APPROVED TO MOVE INTO ACTIVE DEVELOPMENT. FROM THAT POINT FORWARD, THE PROJECT DELIVERY DIRECTOR OWNS THE INTEGRATED DELIVERY OF THE PROJECT ACROSS DESIGN, ENGINEERING, UTILITIES, PERMITTING, PROCUREMENT, CONSTRUCTION, COMMISSIONING, CUSTOMER COORDINATION, AND OPERATIONAL TURNOVER.

THIS IS A HANDS-ON LEADERSHIP ROLE REQUIRING BOTH STRATEGIC OVERSIGHT AND THE ABILITY TO DRIVE EXECUTION ACROSS MULTIPLE PROJECTS, CONSULTANTS, CONTRACTORS, UTILITIES, VENDORS, AND INTERNAL TEAMS.

PROJECTS WILL TYPICALLY RANGE FROM 25 MW TO 100+ MW, INCLUDING AI/HPC, HIGH-DENSITY COMPUTE, AND MISSION-CRITICAL DATA CENTER INFRASTRUCTURE.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • OWN END-TO-END PROJECT DELIVERY FROM SITE ORIGINATION HANDOFF THROUGH COMMISSIONING AND TURNOVER TO OPERATIONS.
    • DEVELOP AND MANAGE THE OVERALL PROJECT EXECUTION PLAN, INCLUDING SCHEDULE, BUDGET, MILESTONES, RESOURCES, RISKS, AND CRITICAL DEPENDENCIES.
    • LEAD AND COORDINATE CROSS-FUNCTIONAL TEAMS ACROSS ENGINEERING, CONSTRUCTION, ENERGY/POWER, PROCUREMENT, FINANCE, LEGAL, OPERATIONS, AND EXTERNAL CONSULTANTS.
    • OVERSEE CONTRACTORS, CONSULTANTS, AND MAJOR VENDORS TO ENSURE PROJECTS REMAIN ALIGNED WITH TECHNICAL, SCHEDULE, BUDGET, QUALITY, AND SAFETY REQUIREMENTS.
    • DRIVE RESOLUTION OF PROJECT ISSUES AND RISKS, INCLUDING SCHEDULE DELAYS, COST VARIANCES, DESIGN CONFLICTS, UTILITY DEPENDENCIES, AND SCOPE CHANGES.
    • MANAGE PROJECT FINANCIAL PERFORMANCE AND CONTROLS, INCLUDING BUDGETS, FORECASTS, COMMITTED COSTS, CONTINGENCY, AND COST-TO-COMPLETE.
    • MAINTAIN THE INTEGRATED PROJECT SCHEDULE, WITH PARTICULAR FOCUS ON UTILITIES, LONG-LEAD EQUIPMENT, ENERGIZATION, CONSTRUCTION COMPLETION, AND COMMISSIONING.
    • LEAD COMMISSIONING AND OPERATIONAL READINESS, ENSURING THE FACILITY IS FULLY TESTED, DOCUMENTED, AND READY FOR ACCEPTANCE.
    • SERVE AS THE SENIOR DELIVERY INTERFACE WITH CUSTOMERS, CONTRACTORS, UTILITIES, AND KEY PROJECT STAKEHOLDERS.
    • PROVIDE EXECUTIVE REPORTING ON PROJECT STATUS, SCHEDULE, BUDGET, RISKS, AND READY-FOR-SERVICE DATES.
    • BUILD SCALABLE PROJECT DELIVERY PROCESSES AND TEAMS AS THE COMPANY’S DEVELOPMENT PIPELINE GROWS.

    PROJECT DEVELOPMENT & DESIGN MANAGEMENT
    • LEAD DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT FROM SITE HANDOFF THROUGH CONSTRUCTION-READY DOCUMENTATION, ENSURING TECHNICAL, CUSTOMER, AND OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS ARE MET.

    UTILITY & INFRASTRUCTURE COORDINATION
    • COORDINATE POWER, WATER, FIBER, AND SITE INFRASTRUCTURE TO SUPPORT PROJECT SCHEDULE, ENERGIZATION, AND READY-FOR-SERVICE MILESTONES.

    CONSTRUCTION & PROCUREMENT OVERSIGHT
    • OVERSEE CONTRACTORS, VENDORS, CONSTRUCTION EXECUTION, AND LONG-LEAD PROCUREMENT WITH FOCUS ON SAFETY, QUALITY, COST, AND SCHEDULE.

    PROJECT CONTROLS & FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
    • MANAGE PROJECT BUDGET, SCHEDULE, RISK, FORECASTS, AND CHANGE CONTROL, AND DRIVE CORRECTIVE ACTION WHERE REQUIRED.

    COMMISSIONING & OPERATIONAL READINESS
    • LEAD COMMISSIONING, TESTING, DOCUMENTATION, AND FINAL TURNOVER TO ENSURE THE FACILITY IS READY FOR CUSTOMER AND OPERATIONS ACCEPTANCE.

    CUSTOMER & STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
    • SERVE AS THE SENIOR PROJECT-DELIVERY INTERFACE FOR CUSTOMERS AND KEY STAKEHOLDERS. LEAD MAJOR PROJECT REVIEWS, COMMUNICATE SCHEDULE, BUDGET, RISKS, TECHNICAL DECISIONS, AND REQUIRED ACTIONS, AND ENSURE CUSTOMER COMMITMENTS ARE TRANSLATED INTO EXECUTABLE PROJECT REQUIREMENTS.

    TEAM LEADERSHIP
    • LEAD THE PROJECT DELIVERY TEAM, ESTABLISH ACCOUNTABILITY AND STANDARDS, AND BUILD SCALABLE DELIVERY PROCESSES AS THE PORTFOLIO GROWS.

    PROJECT DELIVERY SYSTEMS & REPORTING
    ESTABLISH STANDARDIZED PROJECT-MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS AND REPORTING ACROSS THE PORTFOLIO.
    EXPECTED FAMILIARITY WITH PLATFORMS SUCH AS:
    • PRIMAVERA P6
    • MICROSOFT PROJECT
    • PROCORE
    • AUTODESK CONSTRUCTION CLOUD / BIM 360
    • SMARTSHEET
    • MICROSOFT 365 / SHAREPOINT
    • BLUEBEAM
    • POWER BI
    • ADVANCED MICROSOFT EXCEL
    • ERP / PROJECT-ACCOUNTING SYSTEMS

    KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS
    PERFORMANCE WILL BE EVALUATED AGAINST MEASURABLE DELIVERY OUTCOMES INCLUDING:
    • READY-FOR-SERVICE DATE PERFORMANCE
    • BUDGET AND FORECAST ACCURACY
    • MILESTONE ADHERENCE
    • CHANGE-ORDER AND CONTINGENCY MANAGEMENT
    • SAFETY AND QUALITY PERFORMANCE
    • COMMISSIONING COMPLETION
    • DOCUMENTATION AND PUNCH-LIST CLOSURE
    • CUSTOMER AND OPERATIONS ACCEPTANCE

    QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED
    • BACHELOR’S DEGREE IN ENGINEERING, CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT, PROJECT MANAGEMENT, OPERATIONS, BUSINESS, OR A RELATED FIELD.
    • 8+ YEARS OF PROGRESSIVE EXPERIENCE DELIVERING COMPLEX CAPITAL PROJECTS, PREFERABLY WITHIN DATA CENTERS, MISSION-CRITICAL FACILITIES, POWER INFRASTRUCTURE, OR SIMILAR ENVIRONMENTS.
    • DEMONSTRATED RESPONSIBILITY FOR PROJECTS FROM DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT THROUGH CONSTRUCTION AND COMMISSIONING.
    • EXPERIENCE MANAGING LARGE AND COMPLEX CAPITAL PROJECTS, PREFERABLY IN THE $50M+ RANGE.
    • STRONG KNOWLEDGE OF PROJECT CONTROLS, SCHEDULING, BUDGETING, PROCUREMENT, RISK MANAGEMENT, CONTRACT ADMINISTRATION, AND CHANGE MANAGEMENT.
    • DEMONSTRATED ABILITY TO MANAGE CONTRACTORS, ENGINEERS, CONSULTANTS, UTILITIES, EQUIPMENT VENDORS, AND COMMISSIONING PROVIDERS.
    • STRONG WORKING KNOWLEDGE OF MISSION-CRITICAL ELECTRICAL AND MECHANICAL INFRASTRUCTURE.
    • ABILITY TO INTERPRET ENGINEERING DRAWINGS, CONSTRUCTION DOCUMENTS, SCHEDULES, CONTRACTS, BUDGETS, AND TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS.
    • STRONG COMMERCIAL JUDGMENT AND FINANCIAL DISCIPLINE.
    • EXCEPTIONAL LEADERSHIP, COMMUNICATION, NEGOTIATION, STAKEHOLDER-MANAGEMENT, AND PROBLEM-SOLVING CAPABILITIES.
    • ABILITY TO MANAGE MULTIPLE PROJECTS AND PRIORITIES ACROSS DIFFERENT GEOGRAPHIC MARKETS.

PREFERRED

  • EXPERIENCE DELIVERING HYPERSCALE, COLOCATION, AI, HPC, OR OTHER MISSION-CRITICAL DATA CENTER INFRASTRUCTURE.
    • EXPERIENCE WITH HIGH-DENSITY GPU DEPLOYMENTS AND LIQUID-COOLED ENVIRONMENTS.
    • EXPERIENCE MANAGING 25–100+ MW DATA CENTER DEVELOPMENTS.
    • EXPERIENCE WITH UTILITY SUBSTATIONS AND HIGH-VOLTAGE POWER INFRASTRUCTURE.
    • PMP, PGMP, PE, OR EQUIVALENT PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATION.
    • EXPERIENCE WITH PRIMAVERA P6, PROCORE, AUTODESK CONSTRUCTION CLOUD, POWER BI, AND PROJECT-ACCOUNTING/ERP SYSTEMS.
    • EXPERIENCE BUILDING PROJECT-DELIVERY TEAMS AND PROCESSES WITHIN A RAPIDLY SCALING ORGANIZATION.

    IDEAL CANDIDATE
    THE IDEAL CANDIDATE COMBINES THE DISCIPLINE OF AN EXPERIENCED DATA CENTER DEVELOPER WITH THE EXECUTION MINDSET OF A CONSTRUCTION AND PROJECT-DELIVERY LEADER.
    DELIVER A SAFE, RELIABLE, FULLY COMMISSIONED DATA CENTER THAT OPERATIONS AND THE CUSTOMER ARE READY TO ACCEPT.

COMPANY BENEFITS:

• MEDICAL, DENTAL AND VISION

  • FSA/HSA
    • LIFE INSURANCE
    • PARENTAL LEAVE
    • VACATION AND SICK TIME
    • SUPPLEMENTAL OPTIONS

raw.title: Senior Engineer, Data
raw.excerpt: Bellese is a mission-driven Digital Services Company committed to pioneering innovative technology solutions in civic healthcare.
raw.description:
Bellese is a mission-driven Digital Services Company committed to pioneering innovative technology solutions in civic healthcare. Our dedication lies in making a meaningful impact on public health outcomes.
Driven by service design, we strive to know the “Why” to understand the healthcare journey for patients, caregivers, providers, payers, and policymakers. Our goal is to design and build solutions that reduce confusion, provide clarity, support decision making, and streamline the process so that we and our partners can focus on providing better health outcomes by improving patient care and reducing costs and burden.

As a Senior Engineer:

  • You contribute meaningfully to the success of one or more projects or products, helping drive positive outcomes.

  • You demonstrate proficiency and specialized skill in one or more key technologies relevant to the team’s goals.

  • You accurately scope, estimate, design, and deliver medium-to-large features while actively reducing technical debt across projects or products.

  • You proactively support and collaborate with team members, fostering a positive and productive team environment.

  • You adhere to established team processes, ensuring a steady and reliable delivery of features to production.

These are the types of things you’ll be working on

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with teammates, external teams, and client stakeholders to ensure quality considerations are integrated at every stage of the SDLC.

  • Test Planning and Design: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and relevant documentation that align with software specifications and user requirements to ensure thorough testing of features and functionalities.

  • Bug Tracking and Resolution: Utilize bug-tracking tools to document, prioritize, and track defects. Facilitate communication across teams to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

  • Quality Metrics and Standards: Establish and enforce standards and best practices. Track metrics to assess the quality of the software throughout the SDLC.

  • Automate Testing Processes: Focus on increasing test coverage, speed, and accuracy to support continuous integration and deployment pipelines.

  • Continuous Improvement: Continuously evaluate and recommend new QA tools, frameworks, and techniques, driving innovation and staying up-to-date with industry trends and best practices

  • Compliance and Regulatory Adherence: Ensure testing procedures comply with industry standards and regulatory requirements, preparing documentation for audit purposes.

  • Performance and Security Testing: Implement and conduct performance and security testing following best practices and business requirements.

Must have

  • Advanced SQL. Window functions, CTEs, and the ability to read a query plan and act on it. You have tuned queries against tables large enough that a bad join was a real problem.

  • PostgreSQL Schema design, indexing strategy, and migrations in a live system.

  • Pipeline Ownership. Responsibility for the pipeline - Github Actions, Jenkins or similar

  • Python. This is the working language of the role — ingestion handlers, validation logic, reconciliation tooling. Fluency, not familiarity.

  • A validation and reconciliation instinct. You can describe how you'd prove two sources agree when neither one is authoritative, and you've had to do it.

  • Comfort with data you don't control. Third-party feeds break, change format without notice, and arrive late. You design for that rather than being surprised by it.

Nice to have

  • Event-driven ingestion on AWS specifically (Lambda, S3 events, EventBridge, Step Functions). Equivalent experience on other stacks transfers - we care that you've built it, not where.

  • Pharmacy, drug pricing, formulary, or payer data experience. Direct experience with any of NCPDP, First Databank, Medi-Span, or HPMS data is a strong differentiator; we do not expect all of them.

  • Orchestration tooling: Airflow, Dagster, dbt, or Step Functions.

  • IAC (Infrastructure as code) - Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK.

  • Experience delivering in a FedRAMP or ATO-governed environment.

  • Data quality frameworks (Great Expectations, Soda, or homegrown equivalents).

  • Applied AI/ML work, particularly for anomaly detection on data feeds.

Security Clearance Requirements

  • US Citizenship or Green Card only - we do not offer Sponsorship
  • US Residency for at least the past 3 years
  • Able to meet the requirements to hold a position of Public Trust, including successful completion of a US Government background investigation
  • Disclaimer: Medical or recreational marijuana use is considered illegal at the federal level, regardless of state laws allowing such, and may affect your ability to obtain Public Trust. See article

Work that matters, with perks that deliver. Discover how Bellese Technologies invests in you through a benefits suite that makes every day better

  • Remote First, Remote Only Culture
  • Four weeks paid time off yearly (prorated based on start date for the first year)
  • 10 paid floatingcompany holidays
  • Flexible schedule
  • Work from home setup including a Macbook
  • Collaborative, learning environment
  • Medical, dental, and company-paid vision insurance
  • Optional HSA account with some medical plans and a company contribution
  • Company paid basic life and AD&D insurance coverages
  • Company paid short and long term life insurance
  • Optional critical illness and accident insurance
  • 401K plan with 3% safe harbor contribution
  • Wellness resources and virtual care
  • Perks Plus employee discounts

You will like it here if

  • You foster a collaborative ethos, driven by the mission to deliver exceptional customer service to clients. You are passionate about Healthcare and changing the healthcare landscape. You’re an out of the box thinker, always striving to know the “why” when it comes to building solutions. You excel in a team-oriented, remote-first environment characterized by mutual respect and open communication. Your adaptability and ability to navigate challenges ensure your success in any situation.
