raw.excerpt: About Nebius:Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy.
raw.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We are seeking an experienced Structured Cabling Design Engineer to support the design and delivery of structured cabling and physical network infrastructure for hyperscale and enterprise data center environments.

This remote position will be responsible for developing scalable, standards-compliant fiber and copper cabling designs from concept through construction and deployment. The engineer will work closely with data center design, network engineering, construction, operations, vendors, and deployment teams to ensure cabling infrastructure meets capacity, reliability, maintainability, and future-growth requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop end-to-end structured cabling designs for new-build, expansion, retrofit, and capacity-add data center projects.
  • Design fiber-optic and copper cabling systems supporting data center network, compute, storage, management, security, and building infrastructure.
  • Develop MDF, IDF, MMR, network room, meet-me-room, and data hall connectivity designs.
  • Create fiber backbone, horizontal cabling, interconnect, cross-connect, and equipment connectivity architectures.
  • Develop single-line diagrams, cabling schematics, rack elevations, patching diagrams, pathway layouts, fiber routing plans, and connectivity schedules.
  • Determine fiber counts, cable types, connector types, patch-panel requirements, termination methods, and pathway capacity.
  • Design solutions using single-mode and multimode fiber, including high-density fiber connectivity and MPO/MTP-based systems where applicable.
  • Specify Category 6/6A copper infrastructure and associated patching systems.
  • Perform cable pathway, tray, conduit, ladder rack, and containment capacity calculations.
  • Coordinate structured cabling requirements with network architecture, electrical, mechanical, architectural, security, and construction disciplines.
  • Review construction drawings, BIM/CAD models, specifications, submittals, RFIs, and vendor proposals.
  • Develop Bills of Materials (BOMs) and support material forecasting and procurement.
  • Create and maintain cabling standards, design guidelines, naming conventions, labeling requirements, and installation specifications.
  • Ensure designs comply with applicable TIA, BICSI, IEEE, NEC/NFPA, ISO/IEC, and manufacturer standards.
  • Support data center capacity planning and determine future fiber, copper, rack, and pathway requirements.
  • Review contractor installation packages and ensure field implementation aligns with approved designs.
  • Support fiber testing, copper certification, commissioning, punch-list resolution, and project closeout.
  • Review OTDR, insertion-loss, and certification test results where applicable.
  • Participate remotely in design reviews, construction coordination meetings, and technical troubleshooting.
  • Conduct occasional site surveys and field inspections when required.
  • Identify design risks, constructability issues, capacity constraints, and opportunities for standardization.
  • Maintain accurate as-built documentation, cable schedules, port assignments, rack elevations, and connectivity records.
  • Work across multiple concurrent data center projects while maintaining design quality and schedule commitments.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience designing structured cabling, telecommunications, network physical infrastructure, or data center infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with mission-critical or data center environments.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of fiber-optic infrastructure, including single-mode and multimode fiber.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

Our Property Claims department is seeking Senior Field Property Adjusters for the Virginia territories of Manassas, Winchester, and Fredericksburg. This is a remote Full-time/Exempt role with field investigations.

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Senior Field Adjuster is responsible for independently managing moderate to complex and high-value field property claims. This role requires advanced investigation, evaluation, and negotiation skills to resolve field property claims. It involves thorough analysis, collaboration with internal teams and external experts, and will require travel on short notice. Strong technical expertise and the ability to manage claims in accordance with policy provisions, regulations, and best practices are essential to delivering high-quality service and outcomes.

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

  • Independently manage field property claims, including those requiring outside field investigations and catastrophe (CAT) response. Deliver empathetic, clear communication throughout the claims process. Educate claimants and stakeholders, affirm next steps, and ensure a positive customer experience. Set reserves, authorize payments, and make financial decisions within authority and contribute to reserving accuracy and efficiency.
  • Lead thorough investigations, assess coverage, and issue appropriate documentation including reservation of rights and coverage letters. Escalate issues as needed. Investigate and manage suspicious claims using advanced techniques and tools; refer to the Special Investigation Unit (SIU) as needed. Maintain awareness of fraud indicators and regulatory reporting obligations.
  • Identify and proactively pursue opportunities to transfer risk to the appropriate entities for the benefit of insureds and business partners. Identify and assign subrogation potential appropriately; set up files to support successful recovery efforts.
  • Maintain comprehensive and detailed claim records, ensuring proper documentation and compliance with jurisdictional requirements. Prepare detailed reports summarizing findings and recommendations. Ensure all claims activities comply with regulatory and company standards. Execute jurisdictional compliance requirements and support others in understanding regulatory obligations.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders including legal, underwriting, vendors, and agents. Lead cross-functional meetings and communicate complex information clearly to diverse audiences. May represent the company in mediations, arbitrations, and trials.
  • Serve as a mentor to junior adjusters, providing guidance on complex claims, compliance, and litigation processes. Support training initiatives and contribute to the development of best practices and educational materials.

WHAT YOU NEED TO APPLY:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience with claim handling. Typically requires 5–10 years of adjusting experience.
  • Must have and maintain appropriate state adjuster licenses, continuing education credits, and a valid driver’s license.
  • Strong Xactimate proficiency, preferably Level II Certified.
  • Strong knowledge of local geography, regulations, and public safety agencies, as well as the ability to build rapport with insureds and navigate the insurance and legal climate. Strong working knowledge of applicable statues, regulations, case law, and third-party legal liability concepts.
  • Skilled in negotiation and developing strategies to influence outcomes. Demonstrates sound judgment and decision-making, including litigation and compliance matters. Communicates clearly and effectively in both verbal and written formats across a variety of situations. Selects appropriate communication channels and consistently demonstrates empathy toward all stakeholders.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage complex workflows and project work. Demonstrates strong time management and desk management skills.
  • Makes informed decisions based on thorough analysis of complex issues. Evaluates risks and outcomes, acts independently within authority, and identifies patterns in claims to support resolution strategies.
  • Ability to quickly assess customer concerns and anticipate questions, communicate and translate complex and technical terms clearly with easily understood language; deliver difficult messages when needed.
  • Skilled in using claims systems and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to use a personal computer and other standard office equipment.
  • Ability to sit and/or stand for extended periods.
  • Required to work on-site as needed.
  • Ability to travel as necessary.
  • Ability to work in a fast paced, changing or stressful environment.
  • Ability to perform work in a noisy/loud work environment.
  • May be required to have and maintain sufficient home-based internet connection.
  • Ability to operate a motor vehicle 4-5 hours per day and to get in and out of the vehicle numerous times during the day.
  • Ability to load and unload equipment and supplies weighing up to 30 pounds from a motor vehicle as needed to perform field work.
  • Ability to bend, walk, and climb for several consecutive hours while inspecting damaged buildings, often with utilities turned off or inoperable.
  • Ability to use a ladder safely to get on and off roofs and maintain balance while inspecting roofs.
  • Ability to perform field work in adverse weather.

Life Sciences Veeva CRM Solutions Architect

**Job Title: Life Sciences Veeva CRM Solutions Architect** **Location: Remote (EST)** We are looking for a Life Sciences CRM Solutions Architect to lead the architecture, solution design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of CRM solutions for life sciences clients. The role will serve as a senior technical and functional leader with primary responsibility for Veeva Vault CRM, while also providing architectural leadership across Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and legacy Veeva CRM environments. The successful candidate will work closely with clients, business stakeholders, project teams, and technology partners to translate business needs into scalable, compliant, and integrated CRM solutions. **Responsibilities:** - Lead end-to-end solution architecture for CRM implementations, enhancements, migrations, and rollouts. - Serve as the primary CRM solution architect and subject matter expert for Vault CRM, including platform capabilities, configuration, data, security, workflows, and integrations. - Define and maintain CRM architecture across Vault CRM, Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and legacy Veeva CRM environments as appropriate to client needs. - Lead CRM-side architecture for integrations and interfaces between CRM platforms and other enterprise systems, including data platforms, MDM, analytics, commercial applications, and external services. - Define life sciences CRM business processes, solution designs, integration flows, configuration approaches, and supporting technical architecture. - Conduct Business and Solution Design workshops with business and technology stakeholders. - Translate business into clear functional and non-functional, solution designs, user stories, process flows, and technical specifications. - Assess existing CRM environments and recommend modernization, optimization, migration, and integration strategies. - Design practical solutions that balance business, platform capabilities, scalability, maintainability, data integrity, security, and regulatory considerations. - Develop or oversee proof-of-concept solutions and prototypes using applicable CRM configuration tools, APIs, integration technologies, and platform capabilities. - Provide architectural leadership throughout implementation, including design reviews, configuration oversight, integration decisions, testing strategy, deployment planning, and production readiness. - Partner with business and technical teams to ensure CRM solutions support key life sciences commercial processes, including field engagement, account and territory management, customer data, call activity, content and engagement, and omnichannel initiatives. - Provide solution consulting and architectural support for CRM managed services, enhancements, and ongoing support. - Work closely with Salesforce and Veeva specialists to ensure appropriate platform decisions and a cohesive overall CRM architecture. - Provide technical leadership for legacy Veeva CRM environments, including enhancements, integrations, support, and transition or modernization planning where applicable. - Mentor and provide guidance to CRM configuration, development, integration, and technical resources. - Lead or direct the work of CRM resources and ensure assignments, deliverables, and technical decisions remain aligned with the overall solution architecture. - Participate in client presentations and executive-level discussions, providing clear recommendations regarding CRM strategy, architecture, platform capabilities, and emerging technologies. - Stay current with the evolving capabilities of Veeva Vault CRM and Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, as well as broader life sciences CRM and commercial technology trends. **Qualifications:** - 7+ years of experience designing, implementing, architecting, or supporting CRM solutions, preferably within the life sciences industry. - 5+ years of experience with Veeva CRM and/or Veeva Vault CRM, with strong hands-on knowledge of CRM architecture and implementation. - Demonstrated expertise with Veeva Vault CRM and the ability to lead solution architecture for complex implementations and enhancements. - Experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud and/or Salesforce Health Cloud is highly desirable. - Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and its role within an omnichannel CRM ecosystem is highly desirable. - Experience supporting or modernizing legacy Veeva CRM environments. - Strong understanding of CRM integrations, APIs, data flows, and enterprise integration patterns. - Experience working with CRM-related MDM, data warehouse/data lake, analytics, and commercial technology ecosystems is a plus. - Experience conducting business, process design, and solution architecture workshops with client stakeholders. - Ability to translate complex business into practical, scalable technical and functional solutions. - Strong understanding of life sciences commercial processes and the unique of pharmaceutical and biotechnology organizations. - Experience leading or mentoring CRM configuration, development, and integration resources. - Strong client-facing consulting skills, including presentations, solution recommendations, executive communication, and stakeholder management. - Ability to work effectively across business, functional, technical, and project management teams. - Strong verbal and written communication skills. **Preferred Certifications:** - Veeva Vault CRM certification or equivalent Veeva CRM certification. - Salesforce certification(s), such as Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform App Builder, Platform Developer, or relevant Life Sciences/Marketing Cloud certifications, is a plus. - Additional integration, architecture, or cloud certifications are a plus.

raw.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Position Summary

The Member Service Representative II is responsible for providing support and coverage to the Contact Center. The Member Service Representative II will interact with members by addressing inquiries and resolving complaints.

Principle Duties and Responsibilities

  • Willingness and ability to exhibit Wellby Core Values every day.

  • Works purposefully and is driven to provide the best team member experience.

  • Proficient in all areas of the contact center, member servicing, and relationship building.

  • Establishes and maintains a positive relationship by creating an exceptional member experience. 

  • Interacts with customers via telephone, email, or online chat to provide support and information on products or services.

  • Fields customer questions and complaints; when the issue is beyond the representative’s knowledge, forwards to the assigned specialist or other appropriate staff.

  • Ensures that appropriate actions are taken to resolve customers problems and concerns.

  • Applies advanced knowledge and experience to situations and can recognize potential risks for fraud or other loss, including reputation loss to a member or Wellby.

  • Maintains customer accounts and records of member interactions with details of inquiries, complaints, or comments.

  • Maintains a sense of urgency and empathy while collaborating with members on issues and action items through resolution.

  • Troubleshoots and resolves inquiries in a timely, friendly, and accurate manner.

  • Escalates feedback from members to management and makes member callbacks to support net promoter efforts.

  • Treats members and team members with professionalism, courtesy, respect, and empathy through challenges.

  • Proactively identifies changes in member’s banking needs and recommends relevant solutions to enhance the member’s financial and life goals. 

  • Provides timely responses to member and other team members requests. 

  • Member Service functions include transfers, loan payments, and all account maintenance.   

  • Educates members on emerging and existing credit union technology and digital solutions such as mobile, online, and ATM offerings for their convenience. Troubleshoots basic issues and escalates more complex issues as needed.

  • Assumes responsibility for related duties, including training assistance of new team members as required or assigned.

  • Completes all mandatory compliance testing on time. Implements processes as required by the Bank Secrecy Act and Wellby policies and procedures.

  • Performs other duties as assigned. 

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSA)

  • Knowledge of Wellby’s organizational functions, and general operating policies and procedures.

  • Knowledge of secretarial practices and procedures, business English, spelling, and punctuation.

  • Knowledge of Credit Union services and products.

  • Knowledge of personal computer, utilizing Microsoft Office Suite.

  • Skilled in operating computer equipment and general office machines such as personal computers, copiers, projection equipment, audio/video, Microsoft Teams, Zoom Video Communications, and adding machines.

  • Skilled in exercising initiative and using good judgment to make sound decisions.

  • Skilled in interacting with staff, management, vendors, and members diplomatically and tactfully.

  • Skilled in responding to requests regarding complex financial information/data.

  • Ability to navigate various digital platforms and understand, assess, and communicate through them.

  • Ability to work in stressful, high-pressure situations.

  • Ability to handle difficult situations with poise and professionalism.

  • Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand. Must be able to exchange accurate information in these situations.

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced team environment with exceptional customer service skills.

  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, orally and in writing.

Supervisory Responsibilities

  • Team member does not have any supervisory responsibilities.

Complexity & Scope of Work

  • The team member performs a variety of related tasks which are mostly routine but are sensitive in nature.

  • Non-routine situations or conflicts are usually referred to the supervisor for resolution.

  • Instructions to the team member may be general or specific in nature.

  • Courses of action are determined by established procedures and/or the Contact Center Manager.

  • The team member’s work is reviewed periodically for accuracy, completion, and compliance with the policies and procedures.

  • Tasks may occasionally have to be coordinated, integrated, and/or prioritized.

Physical Demands & Work Environment

  • The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here represent those that must be met by a team member to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

  • To perform this job successfully, the team member is frequently required to remain in a stationary position 75% of the time. Daily movements include sitting; standing, reaching, and grasping, operating computers and other office equipment, moving about the office; and attending possible onsite and offsite meetings. The team member must be able to exchange information, in person, in writing, and via telephone. Some degree of stress results from contact with management and other team members.

  • The ability to observe details at close range (within a few feet of the observer).

  • Must be able to occasionally lift items weighing up to 25 pounds across the office and load them onto shelves for various needs.

  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

  • Work involves the typical risks and discomforts associated with an office environment but is usually in an area that is adequately cooled, heated, lighted, and ventilated.

Work Hours

  • To meet the department's needs, overtime work is sometimes necessary, and employees may be required to work overtime hours as assigned.

  • Shifts will be staggered (between 8:00 am CST and 6:00 pm CST) and likely will include weekends.

  • Training for the Customer Service Representative position may be conducted on a Saturday.

  • This is a fully remote position open to candidates residing in Texas only.

Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent required.

  • Minimum three (3) years of experience in a high-volume call center environment, or an equivalent combination of education and experience (one year of relevant experience is equivalent to one year of relevant higher education and vice versa).

  • Two (2) years of college-level education preferred.

  • Need to be able to work both onsite and remote based on business needs. 

  • Bilingual preferred.

For All Candidates

This is a Full-Time, Hourly (non-exempt) role.

raw.description:
Position: Head of Inventory Management / Full-Time
Location: Remote

About us

Whizz rents e-bikes to delivery couriers in New York on a monthly subscription. We have our own service shops around the city, a main warehouse in New Jersey, and we run the whole operation on an ERP system we built ourselves. Bikes break, we fix them, and that means a constant flow of spare parts through our warehouses.

Right now nobody is fully in charge of that flow. Purchasing, stock counts and warehouse work are split between the mechanics, the ops team, logistics and IT. We want one person to take the inventory function and run it properly.

You will work directly with the CEO and the operations director.

What you'll do

  • Get stock records to match reality, both at the Jersey warehouse and in the city shops. Set up regular counts and keep them honest.
  • Set min and max levels for parts and plan purchasing around them. Our mechanics run out of parts far too often.
  • Write down how the warehouse actually works: receiving, transfers, write-offs, stock counts. Then get people to follow it.
  • Launch our used parts program. We collect expensive components from repairs, rebuild them in Jersey and put them back on bikes. The process is designed, it needs someone to make it happen.
  • Manage the inventory team.
  • Work with our developers on the warehouse part of our ERP. You decide what it has to do and check that it works.

What we'd like to see in your first six months

  • Stock records match the shelves, with a monthly check that proves it.
  • Minimum and maximum levels set for all key parts, and no more weekly emergencies over missing parts.
  • Rebuilt parts going back into service, and fewer new parts bought.

Requirements

  • 3+ years in inventory or warehouse management. Spare parts, automotive, service or e-commerce would suit us best.
  • You have worked with an ERP or a WMS and can tell us what was wrong with it.
  • Confident with Excel or Google Sheets. You dig into the numbers yourself instead of waiting for a report.
  • Experience writing processes and getting teams to actually use them.
  • You use AI tools in your everyday work.
  • English and Russian. Our shop teams work in English, management and IT in Russian.
  • At least 4 hours of your working day overlapping with New York.

Nice to have: weighted average or FIFO inventory costing, experience with bike or scooter fleets, setting up cycle counts from scratch.

Benefits

Conditions

  • Fully remote, from any country outside the US.
  • Full-time, long-term.
  • Competitive salary depending on experience, plus a bonus tied to results.

What You'll Do

A successful Lead Cloud Engineer will lead the design, automation, deployment, and operational support of cloud services, Azure platforms, and on-premises datacenter environments. This role will partner with application, infrastructure, security, and operations teams to deliver reliable, secure, scalable, and highly automated cloud and hybrid infrastructure solutions.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead cloud engineering activities for Azure platforms and hybrid environments, including infrastructure provisioning, deployment automation, platform reliability, and operational readiness.

  • Manage and support Azure services such as Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Container Apps (ACA), Azure Firewall, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, Azure App Service, Azure Networking, Key Vault, Monitor, and related platform services.

  • Manage and support on-premises datacenter environments and hybrid infrastructure platforms, including Rancher, Linux-based systems, virtualization or container platforms, networking dependencies, and integration with Azure cloud environments.

  • Build, maintain, and improve Infrastructure as Code using Bicep and Terraform, with focus on reusable modules, standards, governance, and secure deployment practices.

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub, and GitHub Actions for application and infrastructure deployments.

  • Drive automation for environment provisioning, configuration management, release management, monitoring, and operational support tasks.

  • Partner with application teams to onboard workloads, troubleshoot deployment issues, improve release quality, and standardize cloud and DevOps practices.

  • Collaborate with security and infrastructure teams to implement secure networking, access controls, secrets management, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.

  • Provide technical leadership, mentoring, documentation, and best-practice guidance to cloud, DevOps, infrastructure, and cross-functional teams.

  • Participate in incident resolution, root cause analysis, platform improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives for reliability and operational efficiency.

What You Will Need to be Successful:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 8+ years of experience in Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Systems Engineering, Datacenter Operations, or related technology roles.

  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services, Azure networking, container platforms, and production operations.

  • Experience with AKS, Azure Container Apps, Azure Firewall, Azure Front Door, Application Gateway, App Service, and related Azure platform components.

  • Hands-on experience with on-premises datacenter management, including compute, storage, networking, Linux systems, backup/recovery coordination, monitoring, and operational support.

  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code using Bicep and Terraform.

  • Hands-on experience building and managing CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub, and GitHub Actions.

  • Strong Linux administration and scripting experience, with practical knowledge of Bash, PowerShell, or similar automation tools.

  • Experience managing or supporting on-premises datacenter platforms, hybrid infrastructure, Rancher, Linux systems, and containerized workloads.

  • Solid understanding of source control, branching strategies, release management, deployment governance, and environment promotion processes.

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex applications, infrastructure, networking, pipeline, and platform issues across cloud and hybrid environments.

What You May Need to be Successful:

  • Relevant Azure certifications, Kubernetes certifications, or DevOps-related certifications are preferred.

  • Demonstrated success leading cloud modernization, platform automation, migration, datacenter modernization, or DevOps transformation initiatives.

  • Experience with observability tools, log analytics, alerting, dashboards, SLO/SLA reporting, and operational metrics.

  • Experience working with security frameworks, policy-as-code, cloud governance, vulnerability management, and compliance controls.

  • Experience with multi-cloud or hybrid cloud environments, including integration between Azure and on-premises infrastructure.

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to engineering, security, operations, and leadership stakeholders.

raw.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.

About the Role

  • Welocalize is expanding its network of accessibility testers to validate the language-specific accessibility of localized digital content: web pages, applications, and documents.
  • You will serve as a native-language expert reviewer, confirming that accessibility elements not only survive translation but are accurate, understandable, and functional in the Dutch.
  • This role requires fluency in the target language, hands-on experience with assistive technology in that language, and familiarity with Digital Accessibility standards and guidelines such as PDF/UA, WCAG 2.1 & 2.2, and EN 301 549 to complement accessibility testing done internally.
  • Work is assigned on a project basis. You will receive a defined scope, a testing checklist, and access credentials. Findings are reported in a structured defect log and specific bug tracking system.

What You Will Do

The actual scope will vary by assignment, but the general extent of this role is outlined below.

  • Language Validation: Confirm correct language codes in HTML and PDF metadata, and identify mixed-language content missing proper declarations.
  • In-Language Screen Reader Testing: Using native-language screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver, TalkBack, or Narrator), review translated accessible text — including hidden elements, tooltips, error messages, alt text, and UI labels — for accuracy, natural phrasing, and clarity when read aloud.
  • Multimedia Accessibility Review: Evaluate captions, transcripts, and audio descriptions for accuracy, synchronization, and natural language, and confirm multimedia controls are properly labeled in the target language.
  • Defect Reporting: Log findings with WCAG/PDF-UA references, supporting screenshots or recordings, and severity classifications; participate in review calls with the QA Lead as needed.

What We Are Looking For

Required

  • Native or near-native fluency in Dutch; you are the authoritative voice on whether translated content reads naturally and is understandable.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience testing digital content with assistive technology/AT.
  • Working knowledge of WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 AA and EN 301 549.
  • Ability to evaluate content from a native-speaker accessibility perspective — not just technical compliance, but real-world usability for screen reader users who speak the language.
  • Reliable access to relevant devices and operating systems to replicate real-world usage in the target locale.

Nice to have

  • Strong written communication skills in English for defect reporting and general communications.
  • Experience with PDF accessibility testing using PAC 3 or Adobe Acrobat Pro Accessibility Checker.
  • Familiarity with internationalization, localization, and translation workflows; understanding of how accessibility elements can be affected during format conversion.
  • Personal use of assistive technology.

Tools and Environment

  • Welocalize provides access credentials and a structured test plan per engagement. Testers are expected to supply their own device and assistive technology setup appropriate to the target locale.
  • Commonly used tools in this role include:
    • Screen readers: JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver (macOS/iOS), TalkBack (Android), Narrator (Windows)
    • Browser/screen reader pairings aligned to the target locale's most common usage patterns
    • Caption and transcript review: native video players, .srt/.vtt file review
    • PDF accessibility: PAC 3, Adobe Acrobat Pro (provided where required)
    • Defect logging: Jira bug tracking system is most frequently used

What to Expect

  • Assignments are project-based with clear scope documents, test checklists, and agreed turnaround timelines provided before work begins.
  • Scope for each engagement will specify the exact language, content type, pages or documents in scope, and priority areas.
  • You will not be expected to remediate or fix issues; your role is testing and reporting.
  • Welocalize values feedback: if checklist items are unclear or a finding falls outside the defined scope, flag it and we will address it.

How to Apply

  • Click on Apply Now button and share with us the following:
    • A brief introduction covering your language, screen reader experience, and accessibility background.
    • Any relevant certifications (CPACC, WAS, DHS Trusted Tester, or equivalent).

Assistant Professors in Business are full-time employed faculty in the School of Business, Technology, and Health Care who provide a variety of educational services to learners in the undergraduate Bachelor of Science in Business (BS Business) and the graduate Master of Business Administration (MBA) and Master of Science in Human Resource Management (MSHRM) programs. Reporting to the Academic Program Director, Assistant Professors are responsible for meeting the expectations and requirements of Capella University while establishing and maintaining effective relationships with learners, colleagues, staff, and administration. Assistant Professors are able to perform well in all key accountabilities of the role, are nimble and flexible and expected to be able and willing to take on essential roles and other duties as needed or assigned by the Academic Program Director. Assistant Professors ensure that learners receive quality educational experiences consistent with stated course outcomes as well as HLC and any specialized program accreditation standards. They provide high-quality, impactful, and inclusive experiences that deliver exceptional learning outcomes. Capella values the scholarly-practitioner model and expects Assistant Professors to continue learning and development through participation in scholarly activities or professional practice in the discipline. Among the responsibilities that Assistant Professors are expected to perform include: teaching (online) and contributing to curriculum development. Assistant Professors also participate in school governance through faculty committees and may participate in a variety of other activities based upon the university’s needs and the faculty member’s unique skill set.

Assistant Professors supporting the Business programs in the School of Business, Technology, and Health Care are full-time employed faculty who provide a variety of educational services to degree, certificate, and non-degree learners in the undergraduate BS Business program and the graduate MBA and MSHRM programs. Reporting to the Academic Program Director, Assistant Professors are responsible for meeting the expectations and requirements of Capella University while establishing and maintaining effective relationships with learners, colleagues, staff, and administration.

Assistant Professors are able to perform well in all key accountabilities of the role, are nimble and flexible, and are expected to be able and willing to take on essential roles and other duties as needed or assigned by the Academic Program Director. Assistant Professors ensure that learners receive quality educational experiences consistent with stated course outcomes, as well as HLC and any applicable program accreditation standards. They provide high-quality, impactful, and inclusive experiences that deliver exceptional learning outcomes.

Capella values the scholarly-practitioner model and expects Assistant Professors to continue learning and development through participation in scholarly activities or professional practice in the discipline. Responsibilities that Assistant Professors are expected to perform include online teaching, learner mentoring and support, and contributing to curriculum development. Assistant Professors also participate in school governance through faculty committees and may participate in a variety of other activities based upon the university’s needs and the faculty member’s unique skill set.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Teaching and Instruction – Assistant Professors are highly engaged instructors in the courses they teach. They are sought out by learners and consistently exceed set expectations for faculty who teach courses at Capella. Assistant Professors use course data to constantly improve their individual teaching performance and contribute regularly to the improvement and refinement of the courses they teach. Regularly reviews course feedback and implements change to continually strengthen performance and enhance learner experience.

  • Curriculum and Course Development – Assistant Professors are knowledgeable in the Capella course development process and have demonstrated the ability to work successfully with cross functional partners across Capella to plan and deliver high quality course and curriculum in the area of Business, Human Resource Management and/or closely related field. Participates in the design development and continuous improvement of courses and course materials including course plans, objectives, and outcomes, teaching aids, competency-based assessments, and authentic assessment tools. Ensures consideration of varied perspectives and learner experiences in curriculum design, course content, and study materials, as appropriate.

  • School and University Governance – Assistant Professors regularly demonstrate leadership roles in school and university governance. They willingly assume school and university committee roles as active participants and are effective in driving the positive impact of these governance structures. They are the role models and leaders among faculty and serve as peer mentors.

  • Professional Service and Practice – Assistant Professors are active in contributing their professional knowledge and skills to the needs of their local communities and within their professional network affiliations. They carry the “Capella Brand” and mission to their local regions and communities. Research and Scholarship – Assistant Professors stay current in their scholarly field(s) and demonstrate expertise through writing, speaking and conference attendance.

  • Leadership through Team Engagement – Assistant Professors are expected to take on essential roles and other duties as needed, within the school or university. Bringing their unique skills and perspectives, Assistant Professors regularly contribute to the team whether it be through specific roles, active contribution of innovative ideas, or taking on challenging tasks. All full-time faculty are depended on, and relied upon, for immediate and unplanned needs and must be nimble and adjust to changes as they occur. These roles may include specialized assignments such as faculty and cross functional staff meetings, commencement, residencies, Capella-sponsored faculty development, problem resolution, faculty orientation/mentoring, webinar facilitation, course revisions, etc.

  • Based on school needs and the faculty member’s qualifications, some Assistant Professors may receive specialized assignments in areas such as learner support, program development, assessment, applicable accreditation activities, faculty mentoring, or employer-partnership initiatives.

  • Doctoral Mentoring Opportunities – Based on program needs and the faculty member’s qualifications and experience, Assistant Professors may have opportunities to mentor doctoral learners, chair or serve on dissertation or doctoral capstone committees, and facilitate dissertation or capstone courserooms. When assigned doctoral mentoring responsibilities, Assistant Professors are expected to understand and apply established dissertation and doctoral capstone processes and resources, build supportive relationships with learners, provide effective guidance, and promote timely progress toward completion of the dissertation or capstone product.

Job Skills:

Teaching and Assessment:

Refers to the ability to enable learner academic progression, provide guidance, and enhance learner experience.

  • Understand and apply Capella’s competency-based education model that aligns program outcomes, competencies, assessments, and reports with external accreditation standards and Capella educational philosophy to improve learning.

  • Convey and share content knowledge and relevant professional experience in the discipline.

  • Facilitate learner acquisition of course and/or research competencies aligned with their program.

  • Consider learner differences and appreciate the diversity of experience and interpretation among learners.

  • Effectively assess and document learner knowledge, skills, and dispositions through formative and summative feedback. Monitor learner progress and achievement, and refers learners to additional resources as needed.

  • Display cultural awareness and sensitivity to learner differences and seek information about strengths, needs, and interests of the learner to provide personalized support.

  • Engage learners in effective, timely, and relevant interactions and nurtures a learning community that cultivates a spirit of trust, interaction, and learning.

  • Effectively manage key online course and/or advanced doctoral processes and tools.

  • Provide a timely, visible, consistent, and responsive presence in the courseroom and/or mentoring process, and communicate appropriately and respectfully.

raw.excerpt: About KIRAOur mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.
raw.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is based in the United Kingdom. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our United Kingdom office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Be Here. Be Great. Working for a leader in the insurance industry means opportunity for you. Great American Insurance Group's member companies are subsidiaries of American Financial Group. Senior Loss Control Consultant – Mid Atlantic. Work from home in Richmond, VA, Raleigh/Durham, Greensboro, or Winston-Salem areas.

In fact , we received 98% rating for overall job satisfaction from the participants in our last employee survey. This clearly indicates the passion and energy our staff has for our company and for the job they do . . . and they never want to work anywhere else!

Strategic Comp is a leading provider of workers' compensation insurance for large employers committed to protecting their workforce. As part of Great American Insurance Group, we combine the strength and stability of a trusted organization with more than 150 years of history with the entrepreneurial spirit of a growing business.

Through our specialized insurance expertise and field-based service model, we build lasting partnerships and deliver exceptional results for our customers. Our culture is built on collaboration, excellence, and a shared commitment to serving our customers and one another.

Here’s what you would be doing if hired for the loss control position. Your role would be to provide technically competent Loss Control Services in accordance with company policies and procedures and to provide support services within the territory to help acquire and retain profitable business in accordance with our company objectives. The person hired for this position will work from their home and will be required to travel up to 60% of the time including some overnight travel. A company car is provided.   • Broad knowledge of commercial lines of insurance coverage, engineering principles and loss control concepts, and safety standards and codes.

A Masters degree in Safety and Health may be substituted for one of the professional designations.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with innovative technology projects. Our mission is to help develop high-quality AI technologies by combining real-world expertise from professionals across the globe with advanced AI development efforts.

About the Role

This is a freelance role for a Tendem project. As a Web Designer, your focus will be on marketing pages, landing experiences, and conversion-driven layouts. We need a core specialist dedicated to owning the look and feel of all web-based materials, ensuring they feel consistent, polished, and perfectly aligned with the broader brand ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design high-converting one-pagers, pitch-style landing pages, and simple marketing sites based on textual copy, outlines, or existing drafts.

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in web design, UI design, digital marketing design, or visual communications is desirable.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Web Design, Graphic Design, Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), or related creative/technical fields is a plus.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates must have a strong portfolio heavily focused on landing pages, marketing websites, and product or startup one-pagers demonstrating clear hierarchy and strong typography. We are looking for specialists who are confident working from rough prompts, AI-generated drafts, or existing brand systems to convert them into structured, implementation-ready web designs. A user-centric, conversion-minded approach and the ability to work independently are essential.

Technical Skills (Essential)

  • Web & UI Design: Deep proficiency in Figma for creating scalable, responsive web layouts, auto-layout components, and comprehensive design systems.
  • Conversion-Driven Layouts: Expertise in structuring high-converting, pitch-style landing pages with a strong eye for clarity, spacing, and modern design trends.

Additional requirements

  • A structured, user-centric, and conversion-minded approach to design.
  • Strong eye for clarity, white space, and modern web layout trends.
  • Self-directed work ethic with the ability to troubleshoot independently and deliver production-ready assets fast.
  • English proficiency: Upper-intermediate (B2) or above (required)
  • Your CV must include a link to your portfolio with web design examples. Applications without a portfolio link, or without relevant web design cases, will not be considered.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

The Senior Coding Compliance Auditor will assist with the development and execution of the Annual Compliance Workplan including the Auditing and Monitoring Workplans. They will lead & complete detailed Coding compliance audits including complex audits, implement Management Action Plans, prepare high quality audit reports, establish and maintains an Audit the Auditor Quality program, coaches and mentors new and existing Coding auditors, and participate in other compliance program related activities. The senior auditor is expected to work independently with minimal supervision, will manage projects/initiatives as assigned, use analytical and problem-solving skills to assist the auditors with their complex account reviews.

Valuing Differences - Works effectively with individuals of diverse cultures, interpersonal styles, abilities, motivations, or backgrounds; seeks out and uses unique abilities, insights, and ideas. Considers the collective.
Collaboration - Works cooperatively within teams and partners with others, both internally and externally as needed, to achieve success; focuses on the results of the team, not the achievements of one person. It’s “All for One and One for All”
Accountability - Accepts personal responsibility and/or consequences of failure and successes, delivering on commitments and refocusing effort when needed. Someone who is willing to step up and own it.
Time Management - Effectively manages personal time and resources to ensure that work is completed efficiently.
Developing Trust - Gains others’ confidence by acting with integrity and following through on commitments; treats others and their ideas with respect and supports them in the face of challenges.
Takes Initiative - Takes prompt action to accomplish goals and achieve results beyond what is required; is proactive and pursues relentlessly.

  • Effectively and timely communicate coding compliance concerns to Compliance leadership through identifying trends and patterns.
  • Serve as a resource for Coding leaders on compliance audits related questions and concerns. Keep up with coding guidelines and industry standards for coding practices.
  • Create and maintain Compliance audit records, analytical reports, and track and trend compliance audit program activities; manage compliance audit program issue logs and dashboards.
  • Maintains accurate, complete, and up-to-date compliance documents and records and produce for Compliance leadership upon request.
  • Assist with onboarding of the new Compliance coding auditors and serve as a resource for the auditors to address their questions/concerns.
  • Foster a culture of compliance and continuous improvement within the department and the organization.
  • Assist with assessing the Compliance audit program on ongoing basis to identify opportunities for process improvement. Contribute to the achievement of Compliance Department goals and objectives and adhere to departmental policies, procedures, and standards; comply with organizational policies and procedures, governmental laws and regulations and accreditation standards.
  • Effectively maintain open, effective, and collaborative working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist with work assignment of the auditors and follow up on deliverables to ensure deadlines are met.
  • Assist with the development and preparation of the annual risk assessment and work plan.
  • Help evaluate the adequacy and effectiveness of internal and operational controls designed to ensure that processes and practices lead to appropriate execution of regulatory requirements and guidelines related to corporate integrity and compliance.
  • Participate in other projects as assigned and complete tasks within requested timeframes. Participate in periodic compliance program effectiveness evaluations.

Partners closely with operational leaders and end users to translate business requirements into reliable Epic configuration, integrations, and reporting—supporting safe patient care, efficient revenue cycle operations, and regulatory compliance while achieving Service Level Agreements (SLAs) relative to the supported applications. Provides technical expertise by enforcing the vision of the application and safeguarding the integrity and security of the application environment and training in collaboration and partnership with architects, tech leads and engineers. Leads process improvement activities related to Application Management and training for Epic and related third party applications. The Senior System Analyst Epic encompasses two closely related role focus areas: Application Build and Application Training. Project Management:

Strong knowledge with various project management approaches, e.g. waterfall, agile.

Partner with analytics teams on Clarity/Caboodle extracts, registries, and operational reporting needs.
Ensure data integrity and metric definitions are consistent across modules and stakeholders. Compliance & Risk:
Support regulatory readiness (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission), audit needs, and policy alignment.
Embed privacy/security controls, including sensitive record handling and audit trails.

raw.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Stockbroking.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is based in Japan. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Japan office at least 3 days per week.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Over 8,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

  • Partner with cross-functional teams (Engineering, People, Legal, Finance) to support onboarding, tooling, access, and security needs

  • 7+ years of experience in IT, including experience leading or mentoring others in a team environment
  • Strong player-coach mindset — comfortable leading while staying hands-on in execution
  • Experience working in high-growth or startup environments, where processes are evolving and adaptability is key
  • Solid understanding of modern IT systems and tooling (e.g., IDP, MDM, EDR, VPN, DLP) and SaaS-based environments
  • Experience supporting or partnering on compliance and security frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001)
  • Strong operational instincts — able to prioritize effectively, manage competing demands, and drive work forward
  • Clear, proactive communicator who can work effectively across teams in a remote, asynchronous environment

Compensation & Benefits

We believe in transparency. The salary for this role is $158,000 - $180,000 USD (or equivalent in local currency) depending on experience and subject to market rate adjustment.

Zone 1: $189,000 - $216,000 USD

Zone 2: $173,000 - $198,000 USD

We also offer 16 weeks paid parental leave, unlimited PTO, stipends for remote work and wellness, a professional development budget, and more.

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  • 45-minute video call with Hiring Manager
  • 3 x 30-minute video call with Cross-Functional Partners

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Sidecar Health is redefining health insurance. Our mission is to make excellent healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone. We know that to accomplish this lofty mission, we need driven people who will make things happen.

The passionate people who make up Sidecar Health’s team come from all over, with backgrounds as tech leaders, policy makers, healthcare professionals, and beyond. And they all have one thing in common—the desire to fix a broken system and make it more personalized, affordable, and transparent.

If you want to use your talents to transform healthcare in the United States, come join us!

About the Role

We're looking for a Vice President of Marketing to lead the engine that drives our B2B growth. This is a senior leadership role for someone who has done this before — built demand gen infrastructure from scratch, managed multimillion-dollar budgets, run ABM programs at scale, and knows what a modern B2B marketing stack looks like.

Sidecar Health sells to employers, but our go-to-market is more complex than that. Brokers and benefits consultants are often the primary buying influence. Key employees shape internal decisions. And our members — the people actually using the product — are a constituency that a great VP of Marketing will understand deeply, even if they're not the primary audience for this role.

You'll be energized by the combination of creative strategy and operational rigor, and comfortable in a fast-moving environment where infrastructure still needs to be built, not just maintained.

What You'll Do

Demand Generation

  • Own end-to-end B2B demand generation strategy — from awareness through pipeline creation — across broker, consultant, and employer segments
  • Design and operate a content-driven ABM engine that targets high-value accounts with precision and scale
  • Build and manage a full ABM tech stack including intent data, account scoring, personalization, and orchestration tools
  • Partner closely with Sales and SDR leadership to ensure marketing programs translate directly into pipeline and revenue

Paid Media & Digital Programs

  • Lead paid media strategy and execution across digital display, SEM, CTV, LinkedIn, and programmatic
  • Manage multimillion-dollar media budgets with a focus on measurable pipeline contribution and CAC efficiency
  • Continuously optimize channel mix and creative based on performance data

Content & Nurture

  • Develop a content strategy that supports every stage of the buyer journey — from first touch to close — with assets built for broker, Regional Sales Manager (RSM), and employer audiences
  • Build and own SDR sequences and marketing nurture programs that keep prospects engaged across long sales cycles
  • Own website strategy and optimization, including conversion rate improvement and intent-signal activation

AI & Marketing Technology

  • Champion the use of modern AI tools across the function — from content production to campaign optimization to intent signal analysis
  • Maintain and evolve the marketing tech stack to ensure the team is operating with best-in-class tools and workflows

Team Leadership

  • Lead and develop a high-performing marketing team that executes across channels with speed and accountability
  • Define team structure, role scope, and future hiring needs as the company scales
  • Report to the CMO; partner closely with Sales, Product, and Operations leadership

What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years of B2B marketing experience, with at least 5 years in a senior leadership role
  • Deep expertise in demand generation and ABM
  • Proven track record managing multimillion-dollar paid media budgets
  • Experience working alongside SDR/BDR teams
  • Fluency with modern AI tools and a clear point of view on how to apply them across a B2B marketing function
  • A builder's mentality — you thrive where infrastructure still needs to be created
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to make decisions and report on performance
  • Executive presence — you can represent marketing credibly to C-level stakeholders and board audiences
  • Bachelor's degree required

What You'll Get

  • Competitive salary, uncapped incentive bonus, and equity package
  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • A 401k retirement plan
  • Paid vacation and company holidays
  • Opportunity to make an impact at a rapidly growing mission-driven company transforming healthcare in the U.S.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Vietnam. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Vietnam.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

About the Role

As Revenue Enablement Manager, you'll be embedded in the day-to-day of the teams you support (New Business, Account Management and Customer Success) — the dedicated enablement partner accountable for driving marketing-influenced revenue in the business. You'll own enablement programs and systems across the entire revenue lifecycle, with real latitude to decide what good looks like and the visibility to prove it out.

You'll translate business priorities into strategic revenue-influencing programs, build playbooks, support product knowledge and enable frontline managers and customer-facing team members. You'll keep the Revenue organization prepared for product launches, messaging changes, and competitive shifts, codifying how sales and customer success win and retain business. Your efforts will measure positioning and messaging adoption and customer outcomes in ways leadership agrees influence revenue results.

What You'll Do

    What You'll Do

  • Build the systems that help make Sales and Success motions effective – programs and content that sales reps and customer success managers need to push revenue forward. Examples include: deal stage playbooks with talk tracks, content mapping for sales stages, expansion/upsell strategy support etc. You’ll keep it all current as products, packaging, and priorities evolve

  • Partner closely with Product Marketing and Digital Success/Customer Education to serve as a cross-functional connector, ensuring teams are prepared for product launches, messaging changes, pricing shifts, or competitive developments — maintaining one consistent content library and messaging across every revenue-facing channel

  • Manage content and program delivery — competitive positioning resources, battle cards, objection-handling frameworks, and learning experiences (instructor-led and asynchronous) — applying adult learning principles to program design

  • Own and maintain the Enablement AI Hub and broader enablement tech stack, using AI tools to analyze data, generate enablement insights, and build program resources more efficiently, and exploring how AI can be incorporated into revenue workflows

  • Build a field-adherence framework for your programs and content tied directly to revenue outcomes — how they influence win rate, sales cycle length, NRR/expansion, time-to-value, and churn-risk escalations, reporting progress quarter over quarter

  • Run a recurring enablement performance cadence for sales and marketing leadership, converting data into specific recommendations and tracking every committed action to completion

Must-Have Qualifications

    Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years in Sales/Revenue enablement, GTM enablement, Product Marketing, or a closely related field in a B2B SaaS environment, with a track record of directly supporting new-logo or enterprise sales, account management, or CS teams

  • Able to draw out and formalize what sales and CS leaders need and expect from their teams to improve revenue efforts

  • Cross-functional influence without formal authority; comfortable getting alignment from sales leadership, CS leadership, and Product Marketing

  • Business and product acumen strong enough to translate positioning, pricing, and competitive dynamics into rep-ready guidance and effective programs

  • Data fluency — able to pull and interpret pipeline and enablement data, build dashboards, and present impact clearly to senior stakeholders

  • Strong facilitation and coaching skills for large and small groups and 1:1s

  • Experience designing measurement frameworks (training adoption and/or field adherence to program content) that tie back to revenue outcomes rather than activity or completion metrics

  • Executive communication skills; able to turn enablement data into clear, actionable recommendations for leadership

  • Strong project management skills, able to run multiple programs simultaneously and hit milestones in a fast-moving environment

Preferred Qualifications

    Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted enablement tools, including conversation intelligence, AI-generated call summaries, and AI-powered content workflows

  • Proficiency with Salesforce; experience with call-intelligence platforms (e.g., Gong) and Skilljar is a plus

  • Ed tech or K–12 industry experience is a plus but not required for this role

Example Success Metrics

    Example Success Metrics

  • Sales team adoption of enablement tools and content

  • Win rate/sales cycle length reduction

  • NRR / expansion attach rate influenced by enablement

  • Sales team satisfaction with enablement support (survey)

  • Quarterly enablement ROI reporting to sales and marketing leadership

  • Time-to-value improvement for new customer implementation

  • Reduction in churn-risk account escalations

About Us:

At Ellevation, we develop world-class software to help educators serve the fastest growing population of K-12 students: English Learners (ELs). Ellevation helps school districts transform their Multilingual Learner programs and ensure all students can achieve their highest aspirations. Our product suite includes a best-in-class data and instructional planning platform, resources to build teacher capacity, and student-facing programs to teach academic language.
We are a fast-growing, mission-driven technology company partnering with over 2,000 school districts and more than 2 million current and former English Learners. Over the next five years, we plan to double the number of ELs we serve and drive measurable outcomes for students. Ellevation merged with Curriculum Associates in 2021 to accelerate impact for Multilingual Learners.
